about.title: About This Archive
about.text: An independent public record of the Lagovsky extradition case. The archive collects court rulings, procedural documents, and press coverage to keep the proceedings fully transparent.
about.disclaimer: All documents published here are either drawn from public sources or provided by the defence team in the exercise of their right to public legal advocacy on behalf of their client.
